problem_text:
Select all the situations that can be represented by the tape diagram.
[image]

Answer choices:
A. Clare buys 4 bouquets
B. each with the same number of flowers. The florist puts an extra flower in each bouquet before she leaves. She leaves with a total of 99 flowers. || Andre babysat 5 times this past month and earned the same amount each time. To thank him
C. the family gave him an extra $4 at the end of the month. Andre earned $99 from babysitting. || A family of 5 drove to a concert. They paid $4 for parking
D. and all of their tickets were the same price. They paid $99 in total. || 5 bags of marbles each contain 4 large marbles and the same number of small marbles. Altogether
E. the bags contain 99 marbles. || Han is baking five batches of muffins. Each batch needs the same amount of sugar in the muffins
F. and each batch needs four extra teaspoons of sugar for the topping. Han uses 99 total teaspoons of sugar.
